lead: Salman Khan is best known as an Indian film actor, born on 27 December 1965 in Indore.
As of 2026, he is 60 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He is associated with work such as Maine Pyar Kiya, Hum Aapke Hain Koun..! and Bodyguard and has been recognised with Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor and Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut.
This profile collects the Salman facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Salman Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Salman Khan was born on 27 December 1965 in Indore, and holds Indian and British nationality.
Public records name his father, Salim Khan and his mother, Sushila Charak Singh Khan. He is a sibling of Alvira Khan Agnihotri, Arpita Khan, Arbaaz Khan and Sohail Khan.
He received his education at St. Stanislaus School, Scindia School and Elphinstone College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindustani.

sections.heading: Salman Khan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Salman Khan works primarily as a film actor, film producer, television presenter, singer and television producer.
Among the credits most often linked to Salman are Maine Pyar Kiya, Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!, Bodyguard, Dabangg, Dabangg 2 and Ek Tha Tiger.
